description: Replay request specs against a standard HAR, near-HAR, or webEmbedding network manifest and return deterministic response matches.

consume.description: When true (default), each recorded response is used once, so repeated identical requests step through the recorded responses in order.

har_path.description: Path to a HAR file, near-HAR JSON, or webEmbedding network/manifest.json to replay from.

output_path.description: Optional path to write the replay report JSON.

requests.description: Requests to match against the archive: objects with url and optional method, id, postData. Omit to only summarize the archive.

name: replay_har_requests
